reference_sql:
SELECT t.parent_category, ROUND(AVG(t.units), 2) AS avg_units
FROM (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, parent_category, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY product_id, parent_category
) AS t
GROUP BY t.parent_category
alternatives:
WITH product_units AS (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, parent_category, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY product_id, parent_category
)
SELECT parent_category, ROUND(AVG(units), 2) AS avg_units
FROM product_units
GROUP BY parent_category

SELECT c.parent_category, ROUND(AVG(t.units), 2) AS avg_units
FROM (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY product_id
) AS t
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = t.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.parent_category

other_way.sql:
WITH product_units AS (

)

other_way.tradeoff: A WITH step reads top to bottom, product totals first and then the average, at the cost of a step name to keep in mind.
